text:
Recent evidence supports metamorphic testing for recommender correctness, but does not establish the requested deployment fault suite. A [2024 empirical study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0950584924000156) evaluated six metamorphic relations across LibRec, PREA and Surprise, finding reliability faults without explicit output oracles. A [2025 mapping study, indexed in 2026](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11369779), found limited formal verification across 23 studies. Neither independently validates all five BERT4Rec deployment mutations listed here.

A practical audit inferred from these sources: invoke the actual exported predictor in a fresh process and compare it against the same selected checkpoint, with one model per category and no additional fitting. Record checkpoint, configuration and item-map hashes; verify all four routes. Inject wrong-category routing, incorrect checkpoint identity, one-sided item-map permutations, omitted appended masks and count−1 readouts on short left-padded histories. Controls: fresh reload, batch reorder/splitting, candidate reorder with inverse permutation, and consistent relabeling of item IDs plus embedding/output rows while preserving reserved tokens. These are proposed checks, not published verified outcomes. [RecTools documents appended-mask inference](https://rectools.readthedocs.io/en/stable/examples/tutorials/transformers_tutorial.html); [PyTorch documents evaluation mode and the mutable best-state reference pitfall](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/saving_loading_models.html).

Report score agreement separately from ranking agreement: maximum absolute/relative error and tolerance-pass rate versus top-10 set overlap, ordered-list equality and target-rank agreement, with explicit tie handling. [PyTorch’s export verification](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/onnx_verification.html) provides a precedent for numerical comparisons. Report detected mutations and harmless-control failures; reject an incorrect checkpoint identity even if sampled rankings happen to agree. No measured agreement or mutation-detection results are available from this search.
